pages.title: Soul Observers
pages.text: Wisp Moon only. Scout with a wisp; watch through observers.

Press $(k:ecmoons.moon_ability) to open the Wisp menu. $(l)Pilot Wisp$() sends a small blue wisp out from your eyes and you see through it. Fly with your movement keys; jump and sneak go up and down. It can't pass walls or closed doors and stays within $(l)48 blocks$() of your body.
pages.title: Piloting

pages.text: Your body stays behind, visible and vulnerable: it can't move, attack, use items or interact. $(l)Any damage$() to your body brings you straight back, and so does moving it.$(br2)Press $(k:ecmoons.moon_ability) or Esc to return. Piloting lasts up to 90 seconds; then a 10-second cooldown.

While piloting, press $(l)Use$() (right-click) to place a $(l)soul observer$() on the block face the wisp looks at (within 4.5 blocks). Up to $(l)3$(); at the limit, dismiss one from the menu first. Not where you're not allowed to build (claims, protected areas).

From your body, the menu lists your observers by number. $(l)View$() one to look through it; you can only turn about 60 degrees from where it faces. Observers more than 48 blocks away show as out of range.$(br2)Damage, moving, $(k:ecmoons.moon_ability) or Esc return you to your body.

$(l)Counterplay:$() observers and wisps glow and drift soul sparks, so they're easy to spot; any hit destroys one. A player watching through one is standing still somewhere with their guard down.$(br2)Observers vanish when the moon sets or their owner leaves. No x-ray, no markers: an observer only sees what's in front of it.
